description: Pocket SDR receiver for Cardputer Zero: spectrum, waterfall, FM/NFM/AM/USB/LSB audio and an ADSB aircraft page. Requires an RTL-SDR USB dongle and an antenna.

store.summary: Pocket SDR receiver for RTL-SDR: spectrum, waterfall, audio and ADSB
store.description:
zeroSDR turns the Cardputer Zero into a pocket SDR receiver.

FEATURES
- Real-time spectrum and waterfall on the 320x170 display
- FM / NFM / AM / USB / LSB demodulation with squelch, audio AGC and FM de-emphasis (50/75 us)
- Adjustable tuning step, display zoom, FFT size and sample rate
- On-screen key reference and settings panel (press H)
- ADSB aircraft page: sortable list, detail view with a PFD, and a radar view with a fading sweep, range rings and a large callsign plate
- Runs as the normal user through the librtlsdr udev rule - no root, no background service
- First-run guide (reopen with H) and optional GPS position (gpsd or serial NMEA), with manual override

REQUIRED EXTRA HARDWARE
- An RTL-SDR USB dongle (tested with RTL-SDR Blog V4 / RTL2832U). The app has no built-in radio, so a dongle is mandatory.
- An antenna: any VHF/UHF antenna for the SDR page; a 1090 MHz antenna for the ADSB page.
- The dongle plugs into the Cardputer Zero USB-A port and is powered by the device.

NOTES
- ADSB decoding uses a readsb build with the RTL-SDR backend bundled with the package (/usr/lib/zerosdr/readsb); no separate decoder install is needed.
- Audio plays through the built-in speaker or the 3.5 mm jack.

zh-CN.summary: RTL-SDR 口袋 SDR：频谱、瀑布、解调收听与 ADSB
zh-CN.description:
zeroSDR 把 Cardputer Zero 变成一台口袋 SDR 接收机。

功能
- 320×170 屏幕上的实时频谱与瀑布
- FM / NFM / AM / USB / LSB 解调，带静噪、音频 AGC、FM 去加重（50/75 µs）
- 可调调谐步进、显示缩放、FFT 大小、采样率
- 屏幕按键列表与设置页（按 H）
- ADSB 飞机页：可排序列表、带 PFD 的详情页，以及带渐变扫描扇区、距离环和大字呼号的雷达视图
- 通过 librtlsdr 的 udev 规则以普通用户运行，不需要 root，也不安装后台服务
- 首次启动引导（可按 H 重新打开），支持 GPS 定位（gpsd 或串口 NMEA）与手动覆盖

需要的额外硬件
- 一个 RTL-SDR USB 电视棒（已验证：RTL-SDR Blog V4 / RTL2832U）。程序本身不含射频前端，没有电视棒就没有信号。
- 一根天线：SDR 页面用普通 VHF/UHF 天线即可；ADSB 页面建议用 1090 MHz 天线。
- 电视棒插在 Cardputer Zero 的 USB-A 口上，由设备供电。

说明
- ADSB 解码使用随包安装的 readsb（带 RTL-SDR 后端，位于 /usr/lib/zerosdr/readsb），不需要另外安装解码器。
- 音频通过内置扬声器或 3.5 mm 耳机口输出。
